item.title: IMF approves fourth review of Sri Lanka bailout
item.description:
The International Monetary Fund approved the fourth review of Sri Lanka's extended fund facility on Tuesday, releasing about 344 million US dollars to the country.

The Central Bank of Sri Lanka said the disbursement would strengthen reserves. Officials in Colombo welcomed the decision and said reforms would continue. Analysts said the economy had stabilised after the 2022 crisis.

item.title: Heavy rain warning for Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces
item.description: The Department of Meteorology issued a heavy rain warning for the Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces, with landslide risks in Ratnapura and Kegalle districts.
